content.short: DeFiSafety is an independent rating organization that assesses the security of DeFi products.
content.description: DeFiSafety is an independent rating organization that assigns an overall security score to decentralized finance products based on transparency and adherence to best practices. By applying formal software processes and transparent evaluation methods, DeFiSafety evaluates existing and new blockchain investment protocols to determine how well they meet those standards. The goal is to provide DeFi users with accurate, unbiased, and trustworthy reviews that help them make informed decisions about risk and safety in DeFi. By focusing on reliability and openness, the organization aims to support safer participation in the growing DeFi ecosystem.
